headline: Dress rehearsal banked; a short back half, for good reason
narrative: The session that mattered landed. Thursday's Hollie's Loop x4 plus hill reps was the full kit dress rehearsal — mandatory gear in the vest, poles throughout (hence the triceps), a pre-dawn start, and the longest single day of the plan. Only the race shoes were missing, and they're already in Spain. That's the last big training session for Costa Blanca banked, and rightly a pleased one: it is exactly the kind of long, loaded, poles-in-hand day the race will ask for. Monday's Mellor Cross reps and Tuesday's treadmill block did the rest of the climbing. Vert finished just under target, time on feet a touch over its ask.

The back half went quiet for a good reason — family needed you in Northern Ireland from Friday, and the Lurgan parkrun and easy runs and walks there were exactly right. No apologies owed. Injury watch: no mention of the right quad on descents, the adductor or cramp after Monday's downhill or Thursday's long day, and no flags — quiet rather than cleared, so keep the descents honest. GTCB stays on course. Next week is the last big one before the taper bites: a smaller ask than this week, so hit it well and let the volume fall away.
